Foundations

Colour

Two separately authored palettes selected by the Dubai clock, not one dimmed. Teal replaced brass by owner decision: a warm metal on a warm ground put everything at one temperature. Terracotta means live state and nothing else. There is no category colour — the five-hue rainbow was retired; what kind of night it is comes from the photograph.
